rules.statement: Execute DISCOVER, AUDIT, MODEL, PLAN, APPROVE, EXECUTE, VERIFY, REPORT, STATE UPDATE in order when applicable.
Keep schema, contract, task, execution, evidence, verification, report, intended result, and observed result distinct.
Keep identity, authentication, authorization, and trust distinct.
Keep capability, permission, policy, and operation distinct.
Keep actor and source distinct even when they reference the same identity.
Use canonical relationship vocabulary for new references.
Verification results MUST be traceable to evidence when evidence is applicable.
Promote expected outputs or intended outcomes to observed or verified outcomes.
Preserve historical reports as immutable evidence; corrections are recorded prospectively.
Invent project-specific build, test, lint, CI, deployment, or package-manager commands.
Record destructive-operation authorization explicitly and stop when authorization is ambiguous.
